notes.title: PROGRESS UPDATE | NEWS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181161/c21e5d12f4f6d122b8e54affd21a96cd6d717956.png[/img]

[b]Small Nights[/b] is coming up rather slowly and trying to keep the game bug free, visually appealing, etc.
I am happy to say that, the [b]DEMO[/b] is rather close! 

Try not to raise your expectations to high though!

Sorry for a very long wait! Once we have enough gameplay, we will make a trailer for the store page and channel. Once that settles, demo wouldn't be too far away.

Expect the [b]Demo[/b] to be roughly 30 minutes! It will only allow you to access the prologue is what we are planning.

For now, enjoy a tiny bit of a reveal of a new [b]character![/b]
